title: Senior Engineering Manager, Brand Ads and Promotions
location: London, England; London, United Kingdom - Deliveroo
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Engineering Manager, Brand Ads and Promotions

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s growth at scale.

About the team

Ads and Promotions powers the advertising marketplace across DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo: sponsored placements, in-app promotions and offsite campaigns that connect merchants and brands with the right consumer, at the right moment.

Brand Ads and Promotion teams build products to enable our brands and merchants to create ads in self-serve and programmatic manner. This will include owning the full funnel of advertising products from advertiser onboarding, programmatic campaign management, and end to end measurement suite of products for our brands and merchants to grow their business on our platforms.

About the role

Deliveroo is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager of Brand Ads and Promotions, to guide the development of world class ad products and solutions. This role will require you to build products utilising distributed backend systems as well as front-end systems to enable our advertisers seamlessly advertise on our platform. You will lead, guide and mentor software engineers, ML engineers, and software managers. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office, and will act as a single threaded leader for our EMEA Ads organisation and manage/grow multiple teams.
Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What you'll be doing

  • Use AI for productivity gains, building applications using AI and improving teams and workflows using AI solutions.

  • Hire, build, grow and nurture impactful business focused software teams.

  • Build scalable products and drive the engineering vision, strategy, and execution for an organisation consisting of multiple teams and sub teams.

  • Plan for long term strategy and engineering excellence. You are excited about breaking down large systems into manageable, sustainable components that can be iterated on.

  • Continuous improvement of software architecture and development process.

  • Cross-collaborate with stakeholders, external partners and peer leaders.

  • Drive planning and execution, balancing short-term delivery with long-term strategic objectives.

  • Diving into technical details when needed to support teams and solve complex challenges.

  • Ensure reliability and quality in everything your team does.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

  • Experience working in software engineering, large scale distributed systems and related software functions.

  • Experience with, hiring and growing teams from 0 to 1, managing through senior leaders/managers as well as building large sustainable teams.

  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a proven ability to operate in a fast moving environment.

  • Experience of performance management, coaching, mentoring and growing teams.

  • Hands-on approach to closing gaps in infrastructure and technical execution.

  • Customer obsessed - you care about our customers globally, from consumers to riders and merchants.

  • Adaptable, resilient, and able to thrive in ambiguity in a fast-paced environment

  • Willing to jump in and open to feedback.

  • Growth-minded - you enjoy driving projects to hit business goals and growing the business globally.

Nice to have

  • Prior experience in building ad-tech

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.
